title: Capstone core: an analysis
description:
Analyse a practice program from this course and document how it works.

```
target: the course's practice target 3 (permission: made to be studied)
findings: 6 (file format, checksum, 2 key functions, a hidden debug option, the main loop)
report: summary, findings with evidence and confidence, open questions
```
hints: Start from the strings and imports, then follow cross-references to the code that uses them (lesson 18.04).
Say how you know each finding; a claim without evidence is a guess.
requirements: Use only the course's practice targets or programs you built.
Combine triage (sections, imports, strings), static reading and a debugger session.
Write the report with the generator from milestone 9 and check every claim once more before finishing.
stretch: Write a small tool that parses the target's file format and use it to prove your findings.
